name: ruflo-agent
description: Local WASM and managed cloud runtimes with bounded dynamic workflows, live capability discovery and session-local mod policy.

guard.title: Agent guard
guard.description: Refuse text sent into an agent runtime (wasm_agent_prompt, wasm_agent_tool, wasm_agent_create, wasm_gallery_create, managed_agent_create, managed_agent_prompt) that hold a key, token or password.

managedWorkflows.title: Managed dynamic workflows
managedWorkflows.description: Allow dynamic cloud workflow creation through this host session. Independent of secret guard.

maxBudgetCents.title: Maximum managed workflow budget
maxBudgetCents.description: Canonical positive integer US cents. Default 2500 ($25). Invalid configured values deny dynamic creation.

allowInlineAgents.title: Allow inline workflow agents
allowInlineAgents.description: Allow dynamic inline agents; off requires predefined agents with separately reviewed tools.
